Compression is prediction. A model that guesses the next byte well can store it in
fewer bits: a range coder spends exactly -log2 p(byte) bits, so a byte the model
expected with probability 0.9 costs 0.15 bits, and a surprise costs many.

fn main() {
    let total: u64 = (1..=10).map(|n| n * n).sum();
    println!("sum of squares: {total}");
}
